description: This file defines the NumPagesFieldRenderer class responsible for rendering a NumPagesField into RTF format within the MigraDoc library. It extends the NumericFieldRendererBase class and overrides the Render method to output the NUMPAGES specific RTF code.

classes.name: NumPagesFieldRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders a NumPagesField object into RTF format, transforming the field into the 'NUMPAGES' RTF control word.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Overrides the base class method to write the 'NUMPAGES' RTF control word to the output, representing the total number of pages.
